agentUtterance.text: I'll send a text to the device you're calling from, so that you can easily view all streaming options. Is that alright?

playbookInput.precedingConversationSummary: As, {identification_status} is "Pass" and {streaming_services} is "disney" then we will prompt customer and ask to send message. If customer say "Yes" or anything affirmative then we will trigger the FLOW: bell_SMS Trigger

playbookOutput.executionSummary: Customer with value such as "netflix", "disney", "crave", "basic"  and "premium" in the parameter {streaming_services} and {identification_status} = Pass will be prompted to send message and will be routed to bell_SMS Trigger flow.
